# Alpha

A fixture starter.

## Suits

Long writing.

## Avoid

Dashboards.

## Axes

axes: ground=light display=serif accent=red

## Surface and colour

Warm paper.

## Type roles

A high-contrast serif display; a text serif. No italic display.

## Composition

Structures: `long-read`, `letter`. Parts: `margin-numbered`, `text-link-cta`.

## Object family

Rules and numerals.

## Motion

None.

## Ambition

Floor: clean. Target: bookish. Ceiling: one full-bleed figure.

## Limits

Accent at most 5 % of any viewport band.
